source_note: Curated real subset of the live Azure pricing calculator service APIs (same JSON the calculator at azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/calculator/ loads). All prices are captured per-hour / per-GB / per-10k values by region; the curation keeps representative sizes of every major series plus every control-plane and storage tier instead of the full 46,781-SKU feed. Captured 2026-09-30.
